name: Night Cartridge
description: A 16-bit console booted as a product: night-blue ground, cream pixel type for Hangul and Latin, hard-edged game windows, an RPG menu marker and small pixel scenes that move in stepped frames. Suits docs, dev tools and playful products.

provenance.notes: Derived design language; no name, logo mark, copy, scenes, sprites, avatar, category emblems or third-party animated sprites carried over. Type uses NeoDunggeunmo / NeoDunggeunmo Code (OFL), the 16px-grid pixel face the reference also uses, because a lighter 12px-grid substitute lost the chunky voice; Galmuri11 / GalmuriMono11 (OFL) is the allowed alternative; Pretendard and Geist Mono (OFL) serve the readable-body switch. Scene palettes are new 12-bit ramps. Dark only, like the reference. Derived, not observed: form fields, select, checkbox, switch, dialogs, toasts, dense tables, empty/error/loading states, stepped line charts, the pixel avatar recipe.
